articles.title: This American Submarine Lost During WWII—Along With 83 Crew Members—Has Been Discovered in the Pacific Ocean
articles.summary: The USS Herring, a US Navy submarine commissioned in 1942, completed eight war patrols during World War II. In June 1944, while operating in the Pacific Ocean on its ninth patrol, the submarine was lost. It is believed to have been sunk by Japanese forces, resulting in the loss of all crew members and becoming a significant part of naval wartime history.

articles.title: Delhi blaze: Hotel building owner arrested after Malviya Nagar fire kills 21
articles.summary: Delhi Police arrested Lavkesh Bajaj, owner of a Malviya Nagar hotel, following a devastating fire that tragically killed 21 people on Wednesday. The arrest comes as authorities investigate the incident, highlighting accountability for safety lapses. This case underscores the critical importance of adhering to building and fire safety regulations to prevent such preventable tragedies.

articles.title: Trump expected to nominate Todd Blanche to attorney general as early as tonight: report
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump is expected to nominate Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche for a permanent role, likely as Attorney General, as early as Wednesday night. CNN reported this, citing sources familiar with the decision. This significant political appointment within the US administration is a key development, reflecting ongoing changes in international governance relevant for current affairs discussions.

articles.title: Life Advice of the Day by the 'Missile Man of India' Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam: 'Dream, Dream, Dream...' – The incredible power of turning thoughts into action
articles.summary: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, the 'Missile Man of India,' remains a timeless icon. His life exemplifies dreams, discipline, and belief for millions, owing to his pivotal contributions to India's defence and space technology. As a visionary scientist and inspirational President, his legacy continues to inspire national service.
